_meta.description: agy 内置 Skill 在斜杠菜单中的说明汉化

patches.en:
description: >-
  Comprehensive guide and reference for the Antigravity Customization System.
  Use to explain how customizations work, their loading priority, discovery mechanisms,
  and to guide the creation of skills, rules, plugins, hooks, and MCP servers.
patches.zh:
description: >-
  Antigravity 自定义系统的完整指南与参考。
  介绍自定义机制、加载优先级与发现方式，
  并指导创建技能、规则、插件、钩子及 MCP 服务器。

patches.en: description: Provides a comprehensive guide, quick reference, and sitemap for Google Antigravity (AGY), including the Antigravity CLI (agy), Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity IDE, Python SDK, slash commands, keybindings, and customizations (skills, rules, MCP, sidecars). Activate this skill when the user asks questions about how to use, configure, or customize Antigravity, AGY, the agy CLI, the Antigravity IDE, or Antigravity 2.0.
patches.zh: description: 提供 Google Antigravity（AGY）的完整指南、快速参考和导航，涵盖 Antigravity CLI（agy）、Antigravity 2.0、Antigravity IDE、Python SDK、斜杠命令、快捷键及自定义功能（技能、规则、MCP、sidecar）。当用户询问如何使用、配置或自定义 Antigravity、AGY、agy CLI、Antigravity IDE 或 Antigravity 2.0 时启用此技能。

patches.en: description: How to render rich interactive HTML widgets inline in the chat or as standalone artifacts. Use this skill when you want to show the user diagrams, data visualizations, interactive controls, educational walkthroughs, or any rich visual content beyond plain text and markdown.
patches.zh: description: 在聊天中内联渲染丰富的交互式 HTML 组件，或作为独立产物展示。当你需要向用户呈现图表、数据可视化、交互控件、教学演示，或任何超越纯文本和 Markdown 的丰富视觉内容时使用此技能。

patches.en: description: Automatically migrate legacy workflows to modern skills across global and workspace configurations. Scans for existing workflows, creates target SKILL.md files, and safely archives old workflow files.
patches.zh: description: 自动将旧工作流迁移为现代技能（支持全局与工作区配置）。扫描现有工作流，创建目标 SKILL.md 文件，并安全归档旧工作流。

patches.en: description: Guidelines for interacting with GitHub and request permissions from the user when commands fail due to restrictions in the agent environment.
patches.zh: description: 与 GitHub 交互的操作指南；当命令因代理环境的权限限制而失败时，向用户请求授权。

patches.en: description: Interactive guide to design and create a scheduled background automation. Use this skill when the user wants to create an automated or recurring scheduled task (e.g. "summarize my emails every morning", "every Monday send me a to-do list"). Also triggered by the /automation slash command.
patches.zh: description: 设计和创建定时后台自动化任务的交互式指南。当用户想要创建自动化或定期执行的计划任务时使用此技能（例如「每天早上汇总我的邮件」「每周一发给我一份待办清单」）。也可通过 /automation 斜杠命令触发。

patches.en: description: How to manage and create plugins — namespaced bundles of skills, agents, rules, MCP servers and hooks that install, enable and disable as a single unit. Use this skill when the user wants to enable, disable, install or uninstall a plugin, when they want to create a new plugin, or when a new customization should be packaged into a plugin rather than left loose. Also triggered by the /plugin slash command. Don't use for the underlying customization system itself — discovery roots, loading priority, or authoring a standalone skill, agent, rule, hook or MCP server outside a plugin; see the customizations guide skill for those.
patches.zh: description: 管理与创建插件（将技能、代理、规则、MCP 服务器和钩子打包为带命名空间的单一单元进行安装、启用与禁用）。当用户想要启用、禁用、安装或卸载插件，想要创建新插件，或将新的自定义功能打包为插件时使用此技能。也可通过 /plugin 斜杠命令触发。勿用于底层自定义系统本身（发现根目录、加载优先级，或在插件外部编写独立技能、代理、规则、钩子或 MCP 服务器；此类需求请参阅自定义指南技能）。

patches.en: description: Discover UI plugin panels relevant to the current task and surface a one-click pill in chat to open (toggle) them in the side pane. Use when a running UI plugin's panel would help with what the user is doing, or right after the user enables a new UI plugin pane and a shortcut to open it is handy.
patches.zh: description: 发现与当前任务相关的 UI 插件面板，并在对话中呈现一键胶囊按钮以便在侧边栏打开（切换）该面板。当运行中的 UI 插件面板有助于用户当前工作，或用户刚启用新 UI 插件面板需要便捷快捷方式时使用。
